# Phase B evals (eval_phase_b.sh: in-dist 2,048 + 6 OOD bins x 1,024 [+ probe]) and the Phase B report
# Generated by scripts/server/jobs/make_manifests.py -- edit that script, not this file.
# 8 jobs, ~1 GPU-h (3090 Ti-equivalent; see the assumptions in the generator).
# Run:  python3 scripts/server/run_jobs.py scripts/server/jobs/B_eval.txt [--gpus ...]
#  or:  scripts/server/slurm/submit.sh scripts/server/jobs/B_eval.txt [...]
# Lines tagged also_in_local_queue are ALSO in the local runs/queue/jobs.txt: remove them
# from one side first. Lines tagged needs_local_ckpt evaluate runs trained on the local
# machine: sync_up.sh --runs NAME and run_jobs.py --mark-complete NAME first, or run there.
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s0 nocontact_s0 probe > runs/eval_nocontact_s0.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s0 mem=3 est_h=0.18 needs_local_ckpt
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-proprio-base-s1 blind_s1 probe > runs/eval_blind_s1.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-base-s1 mem=3 est_h=0.18 needs_local_ckpt
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s1 nocontact_s1 probe > runs/eval_nocontact_s1.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s1 mem=3 est_h=0.18
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-rgb-base-s1 rgb_s1 > runs/eval_rgb_s1.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-rgb-base-s1 visual mem=3 est_h=0.18
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-proprio-base-s2 blind_s2 probe > runs/eval_blind_s2.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-base-s2 mem=3 est_h=0.18
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s2 nocontact_s2 probe > runs/eval_nocontact_s2.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s2 mem=3 est_h=0.18
scripts/eval_phase_b.sh B-peg-rgb-base-s2 rgb_s2 > runs/eval_rgb_s2.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-rgb-base-s2 visual mem=3 est_h=0.18
.venv/bin/python scripts/phase_b_report.py > runs/phase_b_report.log 2>&1  # after=B-peg-proprio-base-s0,B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s0,B-peg-rgb-base-s0,B-peg-proprio-base-s1,B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s1,B-peg-rgb-base-s1,B-peg-proprio-base-s2,B-peg-proprio-nocontact-s2,B-peg-rgb-base-s2 est_h=0.05 note=needs_all_B_train_logs_in_runs
